operator_stimulus: Lift the (l,k) two-vector by rotation, reflection and duality; eliminate redundant linkages once; explain R(l,k)-lk.

objective.scope: General relational arithmetic; the operator has left the domain open. Each route declares its domain, exceptions, and whether a signed interpretation applies. A finite pilot settles only its cases.
objective.statement: Find an intrinsic rotation/reflection/duality lift into a traced or spanned 4D or 8D configuration and one operation eliminating redundant linkages. Recover the two coordinates. Read both coordinates and identifiable additional cells from the same reduced object. At (3,7) exhibit two distinct surviving extra cells. Treat signed cancellations as a separate extension. Then predict C=lk+correction. Compare with the Ramsey threshold only afterward.
objective.closure_rule: Require the literal (3,7) witness and a separately authorized family scope. Require a reviewed proof of source generation, dimension, equivariance, cell semantics, quotient soundness, coordinate recovery, and both universal threshold bounds for one and the same route and declared scope. Numerical agreement and child outcomes alone cannot close the root.

coherence_obligation: forward realization before attachment transport, then invariance under changes of viewpoint and readout descent

semantics.candidates: alternative routes; the root requires at least one complete route, not every candidate
semantics.dimension: Record ambient dimension, orbit cardinality, and linear span separately.
semantics.correction: literal additional cells for the main claim; signed arithmetic belongs to a separate extension
semantics.duality: Each route defines duality and proves its action on cells and coordinate recovery; color exchange is one candidate.

conjectures.claim: At the (3,6) to (3,5) step there exists a 16-vertex avoiding parent with a 13-vertex minus neighborhood, while every 17-vertex avoiding parent has minus neighborhoods of size at most 12. Thus maximizing parent order need not maximize rooted child order.
conjectures.criterion: Exhibit the admissible 16-parent and its root, check the induced 13-child, and certify minimum plus degree at least four in every admissible 17-parent (exhaustive catalogue up to isomorphism or independent proof). A single 17-parent with a 13-child refutes the comparison.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Child means the full minus neighborhood of one root, not an arbitrary induced subgraph. Separate constructive calibration at (3,7): verify a legal 1+4+17 coloring on 22 vertices, proving R(3,7)>=23 only. That lower bound does not establish a crossover at (3,7).

conjectures.claim: For a fixed two-color Ramsey workload, a typed arrow table distinguishing assignments from jointly forbidden literals recovers exactly the immediately blocked moves and their clique witnesses without treating a false derived result as a forbidden input.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the input domain and rule encoding. Compare edge, sign and witness identities with direct clique checks on every admitted partial state. Distinguish unassigned from false. A missing or extra witness refutes the scoped readout.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Immediate witnesses do not decide global completion. The two-Boolean claim-versus-result lemma is an encoding control, not a verdict on this node.

conjectures.claim: For a frozen Ramsey continuation workload and a source-derived translation, six logical roles in three opposing pairs give a sufficient index for the legal completion readout, and each axis supplies a distinction that the projection forgetting that axis loses.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the axis operations, encoder, admissible projections and workload before comparison with the exact completion oracle. For sufficiency, identical indexed states must give identical legal completions. For necessity within this design, exhibit for each axis two states whose projected indexes agree but whose completions differ. A smaller lossless representation in the declared comparison class defeats the corresponding minimality claim.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Six semantic roles, not six mandatory SQL tables. Axis 1 pairs endpoint types; axes 2 and 3 pair independently sourced dispositions. Blocked and ignoring are explicit facts. State how unknowns are represented. Pairing roles as +/- axes gives a comparison geometry; interpreting it as a symmetry of the data or as three necessary dimensions requires separate evidence. The translation and comparison class await specification.

conjectures.claim: For the assignment joins generated from the two forbidden clique patterns, a uniform index construction from the published database literature computes a key for each partial row at each declared join cut. Two rows have equal keys exactly when they admit the same assignments to the remaining edge variables. Key equality gives genuine compression on the declared family, preserves witness provenance through references, and preserves the first empty order.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the literature operator, translation, cut schedule, information available to the key builder and domain. Compute keys before enumerating full completions; use enumeration only as an independent oracle in the pilot. At each cut compare the partition by keys with the partition by exact completion sets in both directions. Require a merger of distinct live partial rows and recovery of their distinct witnesses from provenance. Test (3,3), then transfer unchanged to (3,4). To close the parent at (3,7), independently exhibit the two extra cells and both threshold bounds from the same route.
conjectures.definition_boundary: SOTA denotes a literature-search hypothesis until corpus, translations and family are frozen. One failed translation refutes that candidate. Refuting a bounded literature claim requires exclusion of every eligible translation in its declared scope. No complexity improvement is assumed.

conjectures.claim: On 16 labeled vertices, the complete incidence index of blue five-sets determines the entire pair-color vector uniquely among triangle-free red graphs of independence number at most five. Thus all explicit pair-color entries can be omitted together for exact graph readout on this domain.
conjectures.criterion: Fix the retained index, constraints, labels and requested readout. A set of links is redundant for that readout exactly when every compatible reconstruction gives the same readout after all those links are hidden together. For each catalogue input establish existence and exclude any second labeled color vector with the same incidence, or exhibit two compatible reconstructions differing on a link. Test the remaining 21 patch cases first, then justify coverage of the full domain, including graphs with a complete direct lookup.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Readout agreement is the lossless-elimination criterion; the conjectural content is that this particular index satisfies it over the declared family. Existence is required to avoid vacuous agreement. Record 36 establishes one instance. Storage redundancy and query cost are distinct; literal extra-cell generation remains a separate claim.

conjectures.claim: On the declared residual-graph workload, a proper subset of the candidate OLAP aggregations suffices for every required query, including retrieval of the individual blue five-sets witnessing conflicts.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze dimensions, grain, eligible aggregations, drill-through data, and query budget. Compare pair coverage, disjointness, and six-port compatibility including witness IDs against direct enumeration. Include queries with zero witnesses and the two 34-edge controls. Count all detail retained for drill-through. A wrong witness or an out-of-budget fallback defeats the candidate design.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Microsoft Analysis Services multidimensional cube mechanics motivate this semantic coverage test. Declare the query family, storage and work limits before verdict; completeness is relative to those choices.

conjectures.claim: On a frozen exact Ramsey query workload, the Power BI Import-mode VertiPaq encoding attains the lowest median workload latency among the declared correct implementations under the same memory cap.
conjectures.criterion: Compare an actual Import model queried with DAX to a row-store SQL implementation and a bitset/inverted-index implementation. Freeze graph data, result identities, hardware, implementation versions, tuning allowance, memory cap, cache policy, repetitions and tie policy. Report model size and build cost separately. A faster eligible competitor refutes the scoped claim.
conjectures.definition_boundary: DAX is the query/expression language. VertiPaq is the Import-mode columnar storage engine. The operator's broader most-efficient conjecture remains undefined until domain, cost and comparator class are fixed. An encoding inspired by VertiPaq is a separate implementation.

conjectures.claim: For the frozen Ramsey query family and matrix-plan language, a uniform index-design script selects a minimum-cost sufficient plan among the eligible plans and emits one typed square matrix from which a fixed reader recovers all specified answers and witness identities.
conjectures.criterion: Give the script a graph and workload, freeze its finite plan space, cost model and work limits, then compare matrix-only answers to direct enumeration, including empty results and the 34-edge controls. Charge the axis map and all metadata. Check the selected plan against exhaustive plan search on small inputs. A wrong answer, a required side table, or a cheaper sufficient eligible plan refutes the script's claim.
conjectures.definition_boundary: An index-design script may use SQL. The physical SQL optimizer chooses execution plans; the script defines the logical matrix. The pilot indexes a supplied graph, not a Ramsey threshold derived from l,k alone.

conjectures.claim: Every blue pair belongs to a blue five-set in all 39 catalogued 33-edge residuals and both tested 34-edge controls.
conjectures.criterion: Use pair coverage to recover link colors on these inputs. Distinguish coverage from six-port incompatibility: both controls have coverage and admit six compatible ports.
conjectures.locator: missed_blue_pairs in the 33-edge census and both control rows

conjectures.claim: In every 16-vertex triangle-free red graph with independence number at most five, every blue pair belongs to a blue five-set.
conjectures.criterion: For each of the 2,576 catalogue records, form all independent five-sets and intersect the incidence lists of each pair of distinct red-nonadjacent vertices. One empty intersection refutes the claim: retain the graph and pair. Full coverage confirms the claim conditional on catalogue completeness.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Blue pairs are nonedges of the red graph. This is a coverage claim, separate from existence of compatible ports.

conjectures.claim: For a frozen binary relational lift and face restriction maps, each compatible boundary above the declared cutoff has exactly one filler in the reduced tuple representation.
conjectures.criterion: Specify the tuple representation, restrictions, degeneracies, cutoff and compatibility predicate independently. A compatible boundary with zero fillers refutes existence; two distinct fillers refute uniqueness. To invoke Hackney's d-Segal criterion, verify its coskeletality and low-dimensional Segal hypotheses separately.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Route template pending a specified representation. In a larger language with a free ternary predicate, identical binary restrictions already allow opposite ternary values.

conjectures.claim: For a frozen permutation action on tuple readings, a specified proper component reduction preserves the truth of the (3,7) forbidden-clique formula: the formula is constant on every fiber of the reduction.
conjectures.criterion: Specify the action, discarded components, binary graph domain and reduced reading before comparison. Exhibit two different labeled inputs with the same reading to establish genuine compression. Two inputs in one fiber with opposite formula values refute descent; a proof must cover every fiber in scope.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Fourier extraction retains multiplicity information. The candidate must justify discarding it separately. This node concerns formula truth; component-elimination-37 asks the stronger attachment and cell-witness questions.

conjectures.claim: For each k in a frozen route's domain and each triangle-free graph G with independence number below k, its predicted first forcing order C(3,k) exceeds the order of G.
conjectures.criterion: Compare the intrinsic prediction with independently established avoiding orders from the two-bite construction where its hypotheses apply. One avoiding graph of order at least C refutes that prediction. Passing lower-bound controls supplies a necessary check only.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Conditional on a frozen prediction and its parameter range. Asymptotic bounds test growing-k routes; the small (3,7) pilot requires a finite witness.

conjectures.claim: There exist a 22-cell foam in a tetrahedral container and a uniform intrinsic rule on unordered pairs of its cells such that every triple contains a blue pair and every seven-cell subset contains a red pair. The rule depends only on foam and container relations and commutes with cell relabeling and rotations of the container.
conjectures.criterion: Declare the foam model, admissible geometric data and pair rule independently of a target coloring. Exhibit a realizable foam, compute all 231 pair colors, and check every triple and seven-cell subset. A red triple or blue seven-set defeats that proposed witness. For any 23-cell foam the same total binary rule yields a red triple or a blue seven-set by R(3,7)=23.
conjectures.definition_boundary: The 22-cell geometric realization is the conjecture. Threshold 23 is an external control. Center-to-vertex transport is one candidate rule. Direct red film contact fails at an ordinary Plateau border incident with three distinct cells.

conjectures.claim: The (3,7) link data at T184 distinguish two ordered, oriented two-against-two splits of its four vertices as aim and result. Their joint readings realize ++, +-, -+, -- once each and commute with relabeling.
conjectures.criterion: Specify the native link signature and read both signs before attaching port labels. Verify the attempt meanings and relabeling law. An automorphism preserving all input data while exchanging the required readings obstructs an intrinsic assignment from those data.
conjectures.definition_boundary: The abstract sign tetrahedron (a,b,ab) supplies a comparison only. The native signature and its interpretation as attempt operations require specification.

conjectures.claim: The native (3,7) link incidence at T184 realizes a rooted dual star: one dual role represents the whole cell, and four distinct branches cross its four triangular faces. The branch corresponding to vertex v crosses exactly the face V(T184) minus {v}. This correspondence commutes with relabeling.
conjectures.criterion: Identify the center and branches independently in the source links. For independently read vertex-to-branch correspondence, compare observed crossed faces against the four complements. A missing branch, repeated face, or mismatched incidence refutes the claim for that source. Merely defining a branch by the desired opposite face tests only abstract tetrahedral geometry.
conjectures.definition_boundary: Local center-to-neighbor incidence of a pentachoron dual star only; the center denotes the whole cell, distinct from a fifth port or lattice site. A frozen native link signature is required for a verdict.

conjectures.claim: For the normalized positive-sign seven-point DFT the square reverses indices and the fourth power is identity; complex phase multiplicities are 2,2,2,1.
conjectures.criterion: Four phases describe an action; justify the actual dimension separately.

conjectures.claim: The specified 4-cube cut at |sum x_i| <= 2 retains 14 vertices and removes the two antipodal corners.
conjectures.criterion: For geometric cuts, derive the cutting rule from the inputs before claiming an intrinsic correction. The two removed corners belong to a different count than the two extra cells at (3,7).

conjectures.claim: The ten-state AGL(1,5) orbit of RGR00 and (3,5) admissibility uniquely select the edge decoder up to isomorphism.
conjectures.criterion: For this seed give an independent choice of decoder: four admissible masks yield two graph types. Every such branch under legal vertex addition stops by order 11.

conjectures.claim: For two induced C5 views sharing two roles, the fixed red interface gives 2q+7q^2+3q^3 legal fillings weighted by new red edges; blue gives zero.
conjectures.criterion: A reduction representing this join must retain the distinction between red and blue interfaces.

conjectures.claim: Over the 39 catalogued 33-edge residuals, uniform, vertex-additive and unrestricted nonedge-pair coefficients certify 0, 19 and 39 classes, respectively.
conjectures.criterion: For this certificate family distinguish coefficient order from the number of shared types. Catalogue completeness remains an assumption.
conjectures.verification: reported exact certificate; full replay data unavailable here

conjectures.claim: On residual 1253 a coefficient function of the sorted endpoint degrees, common-neighbor count and independent-five-set frequency attains certificate mass below six.
conjectures.criterion: The reported exact dual gives mass >=157135/24654 > 6. Every coarsening of those 21 classes inherits this bound; a four-type remedy must cut across that partition or change the certificate.
conjectures.verification: reported exact dual; source certificate unavailable here

conjectures.claim: On the ten-position pentagon seed, a seed symmetry that identifies the restricted 8D adjacency operators of two admissible decoders also identifies their legal continuation families.
conjectures.criterion: Compare all four admissible decoder masks. For each seed symmetry intertwining the restricted operators, transport the actual red neighborhoods and their legal extensions by that same symmetry. One mismatched attachment refutes the claim.
conjectures.motivation: 2411.00529v2 section 5.1, Theorem 5.1; trace(A^2) on the retained subspace separates the two tested graph types (20 versus 12), a weaker observation.

conjectures.claim: Exchanging the side and diagonal four-dimensional contrast spaces can realize duality for a candidate reduction: reduction after exchange agrees with exchanging the recovered coordinates after reduction.
conjectures.criterion: Define the reduced-side exchange independently of the input permutation x -> 2x modulo 5. Compare cell identities, incidence, and allowed attachments on the two routes; equal dimensions or counts alone are insufficient.
conjectures.motivation: 2411.00529v2 section 5.1; the pentagon supplies a summand exchange, while the target duality requires a construction.

conjectures.claim: For a proposed (3,7) lift, preserving every allowed attachment characterizes the whole symmetry components that one reduction may discard while retaining the required intrinsic readout.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the lift, its components, attachment contexts, and reduction. Test both directions from both link endpoints. Use the same reduced object to recover (3,7) and identify two distinct surviving extra cells; exhibit a separating context for an essential component.
conjectures.motivation: 2411.00529v2 section 5.1: Fourier extraction retains multiplicity information. The proposed Ramsey elimination requires independent justification.

conjectures.claim: The simultaneous (3,7) clock orbit has 21 points and real linear span four.
conjectures.criterion: Use distinct Fourier characters of orders 3 and 7; verify the 21 distinct phases.

conjectures.claim: A quotient of only the l*k product positions can recover every Ramsey threshold.
conjectures.criterion: Compare maximum possible quotient size at (3,7) with 23.

conjectures.claim: The complete continuation language at a fixed root suffices across all root changes.
conjectures.criterion: Compare the four-role path and cycle after the identical attachment at the other root.

conjectures.claim: Freeze one candidate lift, linkage generator and single reduction together, before calculation or comparison.
conjectures.criterion: Supply domain, symmetry actions, 4D/8D space, trace or span proof obligation, literal linkage occurrences, equality, baseline and a cell-level correction rule. Ramsey values are external controls.

conjectures.claim: Product-clock linkage or face orbits, rather than position orbits alone, supply the cells.
conjectures.criterion: Specify allowed linkages before testing coprime, common-factor and equal-frequency cases.

conjectures.claim: A four-reading incidence lift admits one Mobius reduction over its decomposition order.
conjectures.criterion: Specify precisely which occurrences each cancellation identifies as redundant; justify the signed domain and derive correction witnesses before lookup.

conjectures.claim: Four ordered two-color readings are candidate labels for a lift with sufficient boundary when quotient equality uses continuation in every allowed frame.
conjectures.criterion: Define allowed contexts independently; show substitution and change of root preserve the quotient.

conjectures.claim: An intrinsic partition of coefficient pairs into at most four shared reading types retains the six-port obstruction.
conjectures.criterion: Freeze the intermediate-role and orientation rule and coefficient-sharing scope before fitting. Check all 39 residuals with exact primal certificates or an exact infeasibility witness.

conjectures.claim: The four-type pair-weight representation supplies a reduction to intrinsic cells.
conjectures.criterion: Define equality of weight measurements and derive integer cell multiplicity; an upper-bound certificate alone is insufficient.

conjectures.claim: Eight ordered three-link readings are candidate labels for a lift supporting a single quotient by equivalent assembly histories.
conjectures.criterion: Specify elementary changes of bracketing and prove they preserve completions. Reproduce both colors of the C5 interface.

conjectures.claim: One chosen candidate defines one equivariant linkage elimination with explicit cell semantics. A signed formula must identify its cancelled occurrences.
conjectures.route_alternatives: Any frozen named or novel branch may satisfy this gate through the route journal.
conjectures.criterion: Prove both directions of the proposed equivalence and identify how the reduction counts cells. Retain the same route identifier downstream.

conjectures.claim: The reduced structure recovers the two coordinates under the declared duality; the lift realizes its declared trace or span.
conjectures.criterion: Recover the parameters from incidence without passing their labels through as metadata. Prove dimension including degeneracies.

conjectures.claim: C is the first forbidden order for the same reduction.
conjectures.criterion: Construct an avoiding coloring on C-1 roles and prove that every coloring on C has a forbidden clique. Test the unchanged rule on the declared family.

port_action.statement: Tuple reversal fixes ++ and --; exchanging attempt aim fixes zero ports. Fixed-point counts prohibit conjugacy by relabeling.

ternary_boundary.statement: Two interpretations on three individuals can agree on every directed pair and differ on a free ternary predicate at that triple.

lifecycle: reviewed scoped closures in the route journal; contract verdicts are baseline controls
